How To Use The Power Play NXT
The Power Play NXT is designed for effortless styling with 6 length settings to create multiple looks, from clean stubble to popular styles like fades. Select your desired length, attach the suitable comb and ensure your beard is dry for the most accurate trim.
Switch on the tri mmer and move it gently against the direction of hair growth using smooth, controlled strokes. For best performance, regularly lubricate the self sharpening blades with oil to extend their life.
Cleaning The Power Play NXT
Cleaning your tri mmer is quick and convenient. Use the included cleaning brush to remove loose hair from the blades after each use. For a deeper clean, detach the blades and rinse them under running water. Make sure the blades are completely dry before reattaching. Avoid getting the main tri mmer body wet.

The Power Play NXT features a 600 mAh battery that charges fully in just 90 minutes, providing up to 90 minutes of cordless runtime. Always switch off the tri mmer before charging. Insert the Type C cable into the port at the base of the tri mmer and connect the other end to a USB adapter or compatible phone charger.
